name: cckit
description: Shared Claude Code plugin toolkit — one plugin per independently toggleable behavior

plugins.name: mdlint
plugins.description: Lint markdown files with markdownlint-cli2 after every edit, report-only

plugins.name: lab
plugins.description: Harness experimentation tools — /bench runs variants of skills, hooks, agents, and prompts in isolation, measuring size delta, tokens, time, and cost

plugins.name: prose
plugins.description: Prose revision skills — /korean rewrites Korean to read as natively written, /prune trims what the reader does not need

plugins.name: mirror
plugins.description: Remind the agent to keep instruction files (CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, ...) in sync with their user-language mirrors
